title: Group around Fountain at Historic Mission Courtyard, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot capturing a group of visitors standing behind a circular courtyard fountain encased in a wire enclosure. In the background, lush foliage and classic Spanish Colonial architectural features—such as arched doorways and thick stucco walls typical of California missions—are visible. The people are dressed in casual mid-century attire, reflecting 1960s fashion and leisure activities.
